decision.reasoning_trace: I narrowed down the options by excluding non-speaker items like cases and chargers. I selected five well-rated speakers covering different niches: ultra-portable, waterproof, and aesthetic retro. The EWA A106 Pro (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) is the standout choice because it has an exceptionally high number of positive reviews (over 39,000) and a high rating of 4.5, indicating proven reliability and sound quality for its small size and very affordable price of $17.99.
